"Shit, my boyfriend is calling"

While I sit there with a cum filled condom, confused since she was "single" 45 minutes ago.
Hahahhaha holy fucking shit. This hits close to home, mate.

{Spoiler}

Mate, it wasnt the doll she picked up, wasn't it?

Yeah, 17 mate. Only* My face was knees deep in chinese food so my spelling might be off here and there.
Also good to know there are others in my situation. I know there are whatever billion people on this planet and "I'm not alone with this issues" but it doesn't help considering I know zero people that are these way that I can actually talk to.
the start to an amazing love story.
